messages.subject: About Rqtl-disc
parts:
This group is a forum for discussion of the use of the QTL mapping
software R/qtl. Any member can post messages to the group.

A separate group, R/qtl announcements
(http://groups-beta.google.com/group/Rqtl-announce), has been created
for sending announcements about updates, bugs, and bug fixes for R/qtl.
That group accepts posts only from me.

Everything I post to the announcements group will also be posted to the
discussion group, so there's no need to join both groups. Join the
announcements group if you want just announcements, and join the
discussion group if you want more.
Karl Broman
http://www.biostat.jhsph.edu/~kbroman/qtl
